identificationModule.briefTitle: Envafolimab Combined With Endostar in the First-line Treatment of Advanced NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Multi-center, Single-arm Exploratory Clinical Study of Envafolimab Combined With Endostar in the First-line Treatment of Driver Gene-negative Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With PD-L1 Positive Expression

leadSponsor.name: The First People's Hospital of Lianyungang

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of envafolimab combined with endostar in the first-line treatment of advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With PD-L1 positive expression
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Endostar indication: ENDOSTAR + NP chemotherapy regimen is used to treat Stage III/IV NSCLC patients either untreated or pretreated. This indication is based on a completed multi-center Phase III clinical trial.

Envafolimab indication: Envolimab is the world's first subcutaneous injection of PD-L1 monoclonal antibody.Suitable for adult patients with advanced solid tumors with unresectable or metastatic microsatellite highly unstable (MSI-H) or mismatch repair gene defects (dMMR).
